scripts.build: npm run build -w @cycling-suite/ui && npm run build -w @cycling-suite/catalog
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cycling-suite/ui && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:core
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cycling-suite/ui && npm run dev -w @cycling-suite/catalog
scripts.pack:ui: npm run build -w @cycling-suite/ui && npm pack -w @cycling-suite/ui --pack-destination artifacts
